title: Starhound's on-play trigger does not return a Poro from trash to hand.
expected: Parser (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-return.ts:159-166) emits the tag list "Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro" as filter: [{tag:'Bird'},{tag:'Cat'},{tag:'Dog'},{tag:'Poro'}] (confirmed by return-hand.test.ts:114-130). target-resolver.ts:357-359 applies `filters.every((f) => matchesFilter(id, f, ctx))`, and matchesFilter's tag branch (target-resolver.ts:~741) returns tags.includes(filter.tag) — so a candidate must carry all four tags. Daring Poro has tags:['Poro'] only (daring-poro.ts:15), so it fails the AND and the target set is empty; the disjunction is lost exactly as reported.
observed: Trigger chain-2 resolved with no pendingChoice and no zone change: trash still ['player-1-main-999-ogn-210-298','player-1-main-22-ogn-016-298'], hand unchanged, no log line. Effect target is {location:'trash',type:'unit',filter:[{tag:'Bird'},{tag:'Cat'},{tag:'Dog'},{tag:'Poro'}]} and target-resolver.ts applies filter arrays with filters.every(...) (AND), so a card would need all four tags — the 'Bird, Cat, Dog, OR Poro' disjunction is lost.
